gran-wilde.name: Gran Wilde
gran-wilde.greet: SIT, SIT. THE STEW'S NEARLY DONE. YOU'VE GOT THE LOOK OF SOMEONE WHO CAME DOWN OUT OF THE SKY.
gran-wilde.again: BACK FOR MORE STEW? THERE'S ALWAYS MORE STEW.

topics.a: FIFTY YEARS MENDING NETS IN THIS HOUSE. MY HUSBAND FISHED THE GREEN WATER TILL IT TOOK HIM, AND NOW MY BOY TAM DOES THE SAME, OUT PAST THE CRIMSON ISLE. HE'LL BE BACK WHEN THE BELL RINGS TWICE.
IT GLOWS BECAUSE OF THE SPORES. ON STILL NIGHTS IT SINGS, LOW, LIKE SOMEONE HUMMING IN THE NEXT ROOM. DON'T DRINK IT, AND DON'T LISTEN TOO HARD.
TAM SAYS THE PIRATES ON CRIMSON ARE WAITING ON A LOW TIDE TO GET AT AN OLD WRECK. AND THAT SOMEONE WENT INTO THE DRAGON'S CAVE WITH A LANTERN AND A MAP, YEARS BACK, AND NEVER CAME OUT.

corra.name: Corra Vane
corra.greet: YOU CAME BY THE GALLEON? SIT BY THE FIRE IF YOU LIKE. JUST DON'T GO UP THAT PATH WITHOUT TALKING TO ME FIRST.
corra.again: STILL HERE. STILL WATCHING THE PATH.

topics.a: I WAS QUARTERMASTER ON A SHIP THAT DOESN'T SAIL ANY MORE. THE CREW CAMPS HERE NOW. I KEEP THE FIRE, AND I KEEP PEOPLE OUT OF THE CAVE. MOSTLY THE SECOND ONE.
SHE DOESN'T MIND VISITORS. SHE'S JUST NOT ALWAYS HUNGRY OR NOT. YOU CAN HEAR HER BREATHING THROUGH THE ROCK ON QUIET NIGHTS, SLOW, LIKE A TIDE.
HOLLIS MARR. CHARTED EVERY REEF ON THIS SEA AND SWORE THE HERON WENT DOWN WITH HER HOLD FULL. WENT LOOKING FOR A WAY IN THROUGH THE CAVES. THAT CHARCOAL BY THE MOUTH IS THE LAST OF HIM.

crew.pitch: THE FIRE CAN KEEP ITSELF. I KNOW WHAT EVERY CRYSTAL ON THIS SEA IS WORTH, AND WHO'S LYING ABOUT IT.
crew.perkText: Corra haggles for you: traders pay a fifth more for what you sell.

ilsa.name: Ilsa Venn
ilsa.greet: MIND THE GLOBE - IT'S OLDER THAN THE LIGHTHOUSE. ARE YOU HERE ABOUT A MAP OR ABOUT THE CAT?
ilsa.again: AH, YOU AGAIN. ANY NEW COASTLINES FOR ME?

topics.a: I DRAW THE SEA SO OTHER PEOPLE DON'T DROWN IN IT. FOUR ISLANDS, FOUR COLOURS OF CRYSTAL. I'VE MAPPED THREE.
NOBODY COMES BACK FROM MIDNIGHT WITH A STEADY ENOUGH HAND TO DRAW IT. THE STONE SENTINELS TURN TO WATCH YOU, THEY SAY. I'D GO MYSELF IF I WERE BRAVER.
IF YOU SAIL THE ISLANDS, LOOK AT THE CRYSTALS FOR ME. CRIMSON, ROSE, SAPPHIRE - AND WHATEVER MIDNIGHT GROWS. COME BACK AND TELL ME. THE CURRENTS CHANGED LAST SPRING; THE MAPS NEED IT.

MY GREAT-UNCLE. HE MAPPED HALF THE COASTS YOU SAIL BY, AND THEN ONE WINTER HE WENT TO HOARFELL TO MAP SOMETHING NOBODY WOULD PAY HIM FOR. HE CAME BACK WITH ONE CHART - A CREVASSE FIELD, AND A LINE THROUGH IT - AND NEVER SOLD IT. IF YOU EVER SEE BAMBOO WANDS IN THE SNOW WITH ORANGE RAGS ON THEM, THAT'S HIS LINE. TRUST IT.
I COPY THE OLD ONES. THE LANDMARKS ARE TRUE; WHETHER ANYTHING'S STILL IN THE GROUND IS ANOTHER MATTER.
EVERY SOUNDING, EVERY SHOAL, EVERY HARBOUR MOUTH. THE EMERALD YOU KNOW ALREADY - EVERYONE DOES. THE OTHERS I SELL BY THE SEA.

traveller.name: Ansel
traveller.greet: COULDN'T SLEEP EITHER? THE OTHER GUEST'S COMPASS KEEPS ME UP. IT TICKS WHEN IT SPINS.

topics.a: I SELL LAMP OIL BETWEEN THE ISLANDS. I'M BOUND FOR SAPPHIRE AT FIRST LIGHT - THEY SAY THE TRADERS THERE BUY ANYTHING THAT GLOWS.
NEVER SEEN THEM. THEIR PACK'S BEEN BY THAT BED SINCE BEFORE I CAME. THE INNKEEPER SAYS THE ROOM'S PAID UP A YEAR AHEAD, IN COINS NOBODY HERE RECOGNISES.
SOMEONE WROTE THAT THE DRAGON IS LISTENING. NO NAME. THE INK'S OLD BUT THE HAND'S STEADY. I'D SAY WHOEVER WROTE IT MEANT IT.

crew.pitch: BACK ME AND I'LL RUN LAMP OIL BETWEEN THE ISLANDS UNDER YOUR FLAG. YOU'LL SEE A CUT EVERY TIME YOU MAKE PORT.
crew.perkText: Ansel runs lamp oil under your flag: a share of the profit whenever you make port in Lumar (at most every ten minutes).

morwen.name: Morwen
morwen.greet: WELCOME, TRAVELLER. THE STARS WHISPERED OF YOUR ARRIVAL. THEY DO THAT. IT'S RATHER RUDE OF THEM.

topics.a: I KEEP THE TOWER, THE TELESCOPE AND THE CAT, IN THAT ORDER OF OBEDIENCE. I STUDY THE WEAVE - THE THREADS THAT RUN BETWEEN PLACES, AND THE ONES THAT RUN BETWEEN TIMES.
I HAVE SEEN IT BEFORE. A PILOT CALLED E.B. CAME TO THIS TOWER WEARING IT, A LIFETIME AGO. SHE ASKED WHAT THE DRAGON WAS LISTENING FOR. I DIDN'T KNOW. I SEALED HER QUESTION IN A SCROLL.
THROUGH THE TELESCOPE: THREE MOONS, TWELVE STARS, AND SOMETHING DARK MOVING BETWEEN THEM. IT IS NOT A CLOUD. IT IS NOT A SHIP. IT IS GETTING CLOSER, SLOWLY, LIKE A THOUGHT YOU'RE AVOIDING.

THE MONKS WERE LISTENERS. EVERY NIGHT THEY SAT BY THE MOON POOL AND WROTE DOWN THE SHIPS THEY HEARD PASSING OVERHEAD - NOT SAILING SHIPS. THE OTHER KIND. WHEN THE LAST OF THEM DIED THEY LEFT ME THE BOOK. I HAVEN'T OPENED IT. I KNOW WHAT'S ON THE LAST PAGE.

pell.name: Pell
pell.greet: CAREFUL WHERE YOU STEP - THOSE BEDS ARE SIX YEARS OF WORK. ROSEITE. THE MOST USEFUL SPORE ON THE SEAS.
pell.again: THE BEDS ARE HUMMING TODAY. TIDE'S COMING IN.

topics.a: I GROW ROSEITE. A DROP OF WATER AND IT GROWS INTO SOLID CRYSTAL - PERFECT FOR PATCHING HULLS. EVERY SHIP ON THIS SEA CARRIES A POUCH OF MINE.
THEY HUM WHEN THE TIDE COMES IN. ALL OF THEM, THE SAME NOTE. THE BIG ONES IN THE GLASSHOUSE HUM WHEN YOU SING NEAR THEM, AND THEN THEY DON'T STOP. HENCE THE SIGN.
WE CLOSED IT WHEN THE SINGING DOWN THERE GOT LOUD ENOUGH TO HEAR AT THE BATHHOUSE. THE ORE IN THE LAST CART STILL GLOWS. NOBODY WANTS TO FETCH IT.

zephyr.name: Oro
zephyr.greet: ZEPHYR SPORES! COMPRESSED AIR IN EVERY GRAIN. AND KEEP THAT WATER FLASK AWAY FROM MY STOCK, IF YOU LOVE YOUR EYEBROWS.
zephyr.again: BACK AGAIN? I KNEW YOU HAD THE LOOK OF A BUYER.

topics.a: I BUY WHAT GLOWS AND SELL WHAT BLOWS UP. CANNONS, FLARE GUNS, SAIL BOOST. THE HARBOUR PAYS FOR THE LAST ONE; THE PIRATES PAY FOR THE FIRST TWO.
ROSEITE FROM PELL, SAPPHIRE FROM THE REEF, CRIMSON WHEN SOMEONE'S BRAVE ENOUGH. MIDNIGHT CRYSTAL I'VE NEVER SEEN. NAME YOUR PRICE IF YOU EVER BRING ME SOME.
A STRANGER PAID ME IN COINS FROM NOWHERE ON THIS SEA. SHIP MARK STAMPED ON THEM - LOOKED A BIT LIKE YOURS, NOW I THINK ABOUT IT.
LET'S SEE IT, THEN. CRYSTALS, GLASS, SALVAGE - IF IT GLOWS OR IT'S SILVER, I'LL MAKE YOU AN OFFER.
QUILTED SUITS FROM UP NORTH - I'VE A STALL OF THEM BY THE ROPE. PELL SAYS YOU'LL WANT ONE WHERE THE AIR GETS THIN.

potter.name: Ama Reed
potter.greet: CLAY ON EVERYTHING, SORRY. THE ZEPHYR ISLANDS ARE FAMOUS FOR POTTERY. WELL. I'M FAMOUS FOR POTTERY.
potter.again: COME TO WATCH THE WHEEL AGAIN?

topics.a: THREE GENERATIONS OF REEDS AT THIS WHEEL. WE FIRE THE KILNS WITH SUNLIGHT SPORES - BURN HOTTER THAN ANYTHING. MY GRANDFATHER LOST AN EYEBROW TO THEM. I'VE KEPT BOTH.
GROUND SAPPHIRE, A PINCH OF SALT AND THE RIGHT NIGHT. IF THE SEA IS SINGING WHEN THE KILN OPENS, THE BLUE COMES OUT DEEPER. DON'T ASK ME WHY.

regular.name: Bram
regular.greet: YOU NEW HERE? STICK AROUND. THE BAND STARTS IN A FEW CYCLES. IT'S USUALLY GOOD.
regular.again: BAND HASN'T STARTED YET. IT NEVER DOES.

topics.a: HARBOUR PILOT, RETIRED. I BROUGHT EVERY SHIP INTO DIGGEN'S POINT FOR THIRTY YEARS. NOW I BRING THIS CHAIR INTO THIS CORNER.
THE SHIP UNDER THE GREEN MOON? SIGNED E.B. SHE PAINTED IT RIGHT THERE BY THE FIRE, THEN SAILED OUT AND DIDN'T COME BACK. LEFT IT FOR HER TAB.

crew.pitch: THIRTY YEARS BRINGING SHIPS INTO DIGGEN'S POINT. GIVE ME A WHEEL AGAIN AND I'LL READ YOU EVERY CURRENT ON THIS SEA.
crew.perkText: Bram reads the currents: your galleon sails a fifth faster at the helm.

merchant.name: Fenwick
merchant.greet: BOUGHT A WHOLE CRATE OF SILVER NAILS LAST CYCLE. HAULED IT FROM CRIMSON REACH. AND NOBODY WANTS THEM.
merchant.again: STILL GOT THE NAILS. STILL NO TAKERS.

topics.a: I BUY LOW AND SELL... I BUY LOW. THAT'S AS FAR AS I'VE GOT THIS YEAR.
THE PIRATES ON CRIMSON WERE SELLING THEM BY THE CRATE. SALVAGE, THEY SAID. FROM A WRECK ON THE REEF. SILVER DOESN'T RUST, SO THEY'RE GOOD AS NEW - JUST, NOBODY BUILDS WITH SILVER.

stranger.name: The Stranger
stranger.greet: FIRST TIME, HUH? DON'T LOOK AT ME. LOOK AT THE SCREEN. PEOPLE NOTICE WHO YOU LOOK AT.
stranger.again: YOU AGAIN. SIT DOWN, PLAY SOMETHING.

topics.a: I PLAY RUNOUTS. I'M GOOD AT RUNOUTS. THAT'S ALL ANYONE IN HERE NEEDS TO KNOW ABOUT ME.
THE OLD OWNER LEFT SOMETHING INSIDE IT WHEN HE SOLD THE PLACE. THE KIDS WHO SPRAY NULL ON EVERYTHING KNOW WHAT. THEY CHECK IT EVERY NIGHT AT CLOSING.
A CREW. NO LEADER ANYONE'S MET. THEY MEET WHERE THE MUSIC'S LOUDEST AND LIVE WHERE THE GATES ARE CHAINED. THAT'S ALL I'LL SAY IN HERE.

pip.name: Pip
pip.role: A kid on the District street
pip.greet: GOT ANY SPARE TOKENS? ...NO? THAT'S OK. NOBODY DOES.

topics.a: I RUN STUFF. MESSAGES, MOSTLY. UP THE STREET, DOWN THE STREET, THROUGH THE GATE WHEN NOBODY'S LOOKING. YOU DIDN'T HEAR THAT LAST BIT.
IT'S CHAINED. EVERYONE KNOWS IT'S CHAINED. THAT'S WHAT MAKES IT A GOOD GATE.
MEMBERS ONLY. YOU NEED TO KNOW THE WORD, AND THE WORD ISN'T 'PLEASE'. TRIED THAT.

crew.pitch: I RUN STUFF, REMEMBER? I'M FAST, I'M SMALL, AND I FIND THINGS OTHER PEOPLE MISS. TOKENS UP FRONT.
crew.perkText: Pip has sharp eyes: you gather one more of everything you forage.

nakuri.name: Dr. Nakuri
nakuri.greet: FIRST CONSULTATION IS FREE. UPGRADES AREN'T. WHAT ARE YOU LOOKING TO INSTALL?

topics.a: I TRAINED ON THE ORBITAL HOSPITALS BEFORE THEY FELL OUT OF THE SKY. NOW I FIX WHAT THE DISTRICT BREAKS. EYES, MOSTLY. EVERYONE WANTS BETTER EYES HERE, AND NOBODY LIKES WHAT THEY SEE WITH THEM.
SLOW AT DAY, LOUD AT NIGHT. THE NULL KIDS COME IN WITH BURNS FROM SOMETHING BEHIND THE GATE - ELECTRICAL, OLD, POWERFUL. I PATCH THEM UP AND DON'T ASK. THEY PAY IN TOKENS.

tinker.name: Tinker
tinker.greet: WHATEVER IT IS, LEAVE IT IN THE DROP-OFF BIN. I'LL GET TO IT. EVENTUALLY.
tinker.again: IT'S STILL IN THE BIN. I'M GETTING TO IT.

topics.a: I FIX DRONES, DECKS, CABINETS, FRIDGES THAT THINK THEY'RE DRONES. IF IT HAS A BOARD IN IT, I'VE HAD MY HANDS IN SOMETHING LIKE IT.
A STATION DRONE CAME THROUGH HERE ONCE - ENIGMA MAKE, OLD. IT WAS TUNED TO ONE FREQUENCY AND WOULDN'T LET GO OF IT. FORTY-SEVEN POINT THREE. I SOLD IT ON. I WISH I HADN'T.

miyu.name: Chef Miyu
miyu.greet: WELCOME TO MIYU'S. PULL UP A STOOL. YOU LOOK LIKE YOU HAVEN'T EATEN SINCE ORBIT.

topics.a: TWENTY YEARS ON THIS CORNER. THE TOWERS WENT UP ROUND ME AND I KEPT BOILING NOODLES. THE BROTH IS SPORE-STOCK - LUMAR SPORES, SHIPPED IN SALT. DON'T TELL THE HEALTH BOARD.
EGGS, REAL ONES? CARROTS THAT GREW IN DIRT? I'LL PAY BETTER THAN ANY CART ON THAT FARM PLANET - THE DISTRICT HASN'T SEEN A FRESH EGG IN YEARS.
EVERYONE TALKS AT A NOODLE BAR. THE MARSHAL ON SKYPORT 7 SAYS A SKIFF CALLED THE WREN TRIED TO LAND ON HER ROOF, YEARS BACK, OUT OF FUEL, FROM ENIGMA. SHE WAVED IT OFF. SHE STILL THINKS ABOUT IT.

marshal.name: Marshal Ruiz
marshal.greet: SKYPORT 7, PAD ONE. YOUR SKIFF IS LOGGED. NOBODY TOUCHES IT ON MY ROOF.

topics.a: TWELVE YEARS ON THIS ROOF. I'VE LANDED EVERYTHING FROM DIPLOMATS TO A CRATE OF LIVE EELS. THE EELS WERE BETTER COMPANY.

A SKIFF OUT OF ENIGMA STATION. CAME IN ON FUMES, NO CLEARANCE, IN A STORM. I WAVED HER OFF - RULES. SHE TURNED AWAY TOWARD THE DARK SIDE OF THE PLANET. NEVER LOGGED ANYWHERE ELSE. I STILL THINK ABOUT IT.
LIFT'S ON THE FAR SIDE. TAKES YOU DOWN TO THE SKYWALK, THEN IT'S THE DISTRICT. MIND YOUR TOKENS DOWN THERE.

joro.name: Joro
joro.greet: GOT SOMETHING TO UNLOAD? OR JUST BROWSING? DON'T TOUCH THE CLOCK. THE CLOCK BITES.
joro.again: BACK AGAIN. WHAT'VE YOU DRAGGED IN THIS TIME?

topics.a: THIRTY YEARS BUYING WHAT PEOPLE DON'T WANT AND SELLING IT TO PEOPLE WHO DIDN'T KNOW THEY WANTED IT. I TAKE APART POCKET WATCHES TO RELAX. I PUT THEM BACK TOGETHER WHEN I'M ANGRY.
THAT SAFE CAME OUT OF A SHIP THAT FELL OUT OF ORBIT. NOBODY'S OPENED IT. NOBODY'S ASKED ME TO. IF YOU EVER FIND A COMBINATION WRITTEN ON SOMETHING STRANGE, BRING IT HERE FIRST.
OFF-WORLD CRYSTALS? SALVAGE? I'LL TAKE IT ALL. I WON'T PAY LIKE THE LUMAR TRADERS, BUT I'M HERE AND THEY'RE NOT.
CORP SECURITY PLATE, ONE CAREFUL OWNER. AND A FRAME PACK OFF A SURVEYOR WHO WON'T BE NEEDING IT. DON'T ASK HOW I GOT EITHER.

okafor.name: Dami Okafor
okafor.greet:
YOU CAME IN THROUGH BAY 3? THEN YOU SAW MY BEDROLL. AND MY SUIT. AND THE DRONE. I KNEW SOMEONE WOULD PIECE IT TOGETHER EVENTUALLY.

I'M OKAFOR. I STAYED.
okafor.again: SIT. THE LOOP COMES ROUND AGAIN IN FOUR MINUTES. IT ALWAYS DOES.

topics.a: ENGINEER, THIRD SHIFT, ENIGMA RELAY. WHEN COMMAND WENT QUIET THE OTHERS TOOK THE LAST SHUTTLE OUT. I HAD A TUG HALF-REBUILT AND A RADIO THAT WOULDN'T STOP TALKING. SO I STAYED. THAT WAS SEVENTY-TWO CYCLES AGO.

OUR SKIFF. FIVE CREW. THEY WENT FOR HELP WHEN THE RELAY DIED - ARCADIA FIRST. SOMEONE ON A ROOF WAVED THEM OFF IN A STORM. THEY HAD FUEL FOR ONE MORE BURN, AND THEY SPENT IT GOING THE OTHER WAY. TOWARDS THE DARK.

FORTY-SEVEN POINT THREE. IT'S THE WREN'S DISTRESS LOOP. EXCEPT THE WREN WENT DOWN SEVENTY CYCLES AGO, AND THE LOOP KEEPS GETTING CLEARER. LIKE IT'S STILL ON ITS WAY HERE. LIKE IT'S CLIMBING OUT OF SOMETHING.
LETTUCE, TOMATOES, AND SOMETHING I BRED FROM LUMAR SPORES THAT GLOWS WHEN YOU TALK TO IT. I TALK TO IT A LOT. THE FISH ARE CALLED ADA, BIX, CORA, DELL AND EZE. AFTER THE CREW. DON'T EAT THEM.
IF YOU'RE GOING TO THE BRINK - THE THING ON THE OTHER SIDE OF THE DARK - LOOK FOR A PIECE OF THIS STATION. IT GOT THERE BEFORE US. EVERYTHING DOES.

crew.notYet: LEAVE? WHILE THE LOOP'S STILL PLAYING? NOT UNTIL I KNOW WHERE THEY ENDED UP. FIND THE WREN - OR WHAT'S LEFT OF IT - AND ASK ME AGAIN.
crew.pitch: YOU FOUND THEM. AT THE EDGE. THEN THERE'S NOTHING TO WAIT FOR. I CAN FIX ANYTHING THAT HUMS, AND MOST THINGS THAT DON'T. TAKE ME WITH YOU - AND THE FISH.
crew.perkText: Okafor keeps everything you own running: your businesses hold twice as many hours of takings before they stop.

vex.name: Vex
vex.role: Runs NULL, from a shipping container
vex.greet: YOU GOT THROUGH THE GATE. EITHER PIP TALKS TOO MUCH OR YOU CAN READ. SIT. DON'T TOUCH THE RIG.
vex.again: SKYBOAT. BACK FOR WORK? THE RIG'S WARM.

topics.a: VEX. I RUN NULL, IF ANYONE RUNS NULL. WE'RE THE ONES WHO MAKE THE SCREENS SAY SOMETHING TRUE FOR A FEW SECONDS AT A TIME.
HALCYON MEDIA OWNS EVERY SCREEN IN THE DISTRICT. EVERY ONE. WE BORROW THEM BACK. ART, MOSTLY. SOMETIMES A JOKE. ONCE, A MARRIAGE PROPOSAL. SHE SAID YES.

THE RIG. A FEED NEEDS ROUTING THROUGH A JUNCTION BOX BEFORE HALCYON'S TRACE FINDS THE TAP. TURN THE JUNCTIONS TILL IT FLOWS. STEADY HANDS? I PAY COINS - FIVE JOBS A NIGHT, BIGGER BOXES AS YOU GET GOOD.
THE ONE IN THE ARCADE'S BACK CORNER? NOT ONE OF OURS. THEY JUST KNOW THINGS. WE LEAVE THEM SNACKS.
A RUCKSACK STITCHED FROM SOMETHING THAT ISN'T CLOTH. IT HOLDS MORE THAN IT SHOULD. NINE HUNDRED, AND YOU NEVER SAW IT HERE.

cook.name: Sato
cook.role: Line cook at Cyber Noodles, on his break
cook.greet: FIVE MINUTES. I GET FIVE MINUTES. YOU'RE IN THEM.
cook.again: STILL ON MY BREAK. STILL FIVE MINUTES.

topics.a: SATO. I DO THE BROTH AT MIYU'S. SIXTEEN HOURS ON THE POT, FIVE MINUTES OUT HERE WITH THE CAT.
NOT MY CAT. I JUST FEED IT. IT'S NOBODY'S CAT. IT'S THE ALLEY'S CAT.
NULL. THEY'RE ALL RIGHT. PAY FOR NOODLES IN EXACT CHANGE AND NEVER TELL ME WHAT THEY'RE UP TO. BEST CUSTOMERS I'VE GOT.
HALCYON'S BEEN SENDING SUITS ROUND THE BACKS, ASKING ABOUT THE CONTAINER. NOBODY TELLS THEM ANYTHING. NOT EVEN THE CAT.

keeper.name: Tamsin Gale
keeper.greet: MIND THE LENS. IT'S OLDER THAN BOTH OF US PUT TOGETHER. YOU CLIMBED ALL THOSE STAIRS - SIT, IF YOU CAN FIND SOMEWHERE THAT ISN'T ME.
keeper.again: BACK UP THE STAIRS? YOU'LL HAVE LEGS LIKE A KEEPER. THE KETTLE'S DOWNSTAIRS IF YOU WANT IT.

topics.a: TAMSIN GALE. I KEEP THE LIGHT, LIKE MY DAD DID, AND HIS MOTHER BEFORE HIM. FORTY YEARS I'VE WOUND THAT CLOCK. IT HASN'T STOPPED ON MY WATCH, AND IT WON'T.
THE BLUE IS DAD'S DOING. HE SET A SAPPHIRE IN THE LENS THE YEAR I WAS BORN. EVERY SAILOR ON THIS SEA KNOWS A BLUE LIGHT IS SAPPHIRE - NO MISTAKING US FOR ANYWHERE ELSE.

MY MOTHER'S BOAT. SHE WENT OUT AFTER SILVERFIN ONE AUTUMN AND THE STORM CAME UP FASTER THAN ANYONE SAID IT WOULD. FOUR ABOARD. THE NEW BOAT AT THE PIER HAS HER NAME AND A 'II' ON THE END, WHICH I'VE NEVER LIKED.
SOMEONE'S BURNING A LAMP ON MIDNIGHT. NORTH BY EAST, PAST THE ABBEY. READ THE LOG DOWNSTAIRS IF YOU WANT TO KNOW MORE - IT'LL TELL YOU MORE THAN I WILL.

sev.name: Sev Akana
sev.greet: BALLS IN, COINS OUT. FIVE TO THE COIN, NO HAGGLING. YOU'RE THE SKY-CAPTAIN EVERYONE'S TALKING ABOUT - FIRST TRAY'S ON THE HOUSE, ONCE A NIGHT.
sev.again: BACK AGAIN, PLAYER. THE MACHINES REMEMBER YOU. THEY DON'T CARE, BUT THEY REMEMBER.

topics.a: SEV AKANA. I PLAYED THESE TWENTY YEARS BEFORE I OWNED THEM. WON THE PLACE OFF THE LAST OWNER ON A SINGLE LUCKY 7. HE STILL COMES IN. TUESDAYS.

TURN THE HANDLE TILL THE BALLS DROP BESIDE THE SCREEN, NOT ON IT. THE MIDDLE POCKET SPINS THE REELS. THREE ALIKE OPENS THE DOOR AT THE BOTTOM - THAT'S A FEVER. THREE SEVENS, TWO ROUNDS. THE TULIPS PAY A LITTLE.
SIX BOARDS, EVERY ONE PINNED DIFFERENT. I DON'T TOUCH THE PINS - MOST PARLOURS DO. THAT'S WHY THE REGULARS COME HERE AND NOT THERE.
HALCYON WANTS MY SCREENS FOR ADS. I SAID MY SCREENS ARE FOR SEVENS. THEY SENT A LAWYER. HE PLAYED ONE TRAY AND LEFT HAPPY. STILL WAITING ON THE NEXT ONE.

hob.name: Hob Dunmore
hob.role: The last miner in the Rose Mine
hob.greet: ANOTHER ONE WANTING TO GO DOWN. SIT, IF YOU LIKE - THE ROCK ISN'T GOING ANYWHERE. TAKE A PICK OFF THE RACK; MIND YOUR HEAD ON THE FIFTH FLOOR.
hob.again: STILL IN ONE PIECE? GOOD. WHAT DID YOU BRING UP?

topics.a: HOB DUNMORE. FORTY YEARS IN THIS HILL. THE CREW WENT TO SAPPHIRE WHEN THEY SEALED THE DEEP FLOORS. I STAYED. SOMEBODY HAS TO LISTEN TO IT. PELL GROWS HER ROSEITE OUTSIDE NOW AND BRINGS ME SOUP.
STARTED THE WINTER THEY OPENED FLOOR TWENTY. NOT A TUNE - MORE LIKE A NOTE HELD FOREVER. THE CREW WOULDN'T GO PAST FIFTEEN AFTER THAT. I'VE NEVER BEEN BRAVE ENOUGH TO GO AND SEE WHAT'S SINGING.

FACE A ROCK AND SWING. PLAIN ROCK'S JUST STONE; THE RUST-RED'S IRON, THE PALE'S SILVER, AND THE ONES THAT GLOW ARE WHY ANYONE EVER DUG HERE. ONE ROCK ON EVERY FLOOR SITS ON THE LADDER DOWN. THE LIFT STOPS EVERY FIFTH FLOOR, ONCE YOU'VE BEEN.
BRING ME THE ORE AND THE COIN AND I'LL PUT AN EDGE ON SOMETHING BETTER THAN THAT OLD THING.
FOR WHAT'S DOWN THERE? AYE. STAR IRON AND A SONGSTONE, AND I'LL MAKE YOU SOMETHING THAT SINGS BACK.

MITES FROM THE THIRD FLOOR - THEY'LL NIP. CRABS LOWER DOWN, WITH CRYSTAL ON THEIR BACKS. AND BELOW FOURTEEN, SHADES. WATCH FOR THE WIND-UP: STEP ASIDE WHEN THEY RISE, AND HIT THEM WHEN THEY'VE MISSED.
I STILL SEND A CART TO SAPPHIRE EVERY MONTH. I'LL TAKE WHAT YOU DIG.

hollin.name: Hollin Ashby
hollin.role: Seedsman, the village corner on Verdance
hollin.greet: WELL NOW. A SHIP COMES DOWN ON THE OLD PAD AND OUT STEPS A FARMER. YOU'LL BE AFTER SEED, I EXPECT. AND THE FIELD - THE FIELD'S BEEN WAITING FOR SOMEBODY.
hollin.again: BACK AGAIN. HOW'S THE GROUND TREATING YOU?

topics.a: FORTY YEARS SELLING SEED FROM THIS STALL. MY FATHER BEFORE ME. I KNOW WHAT GROWS HERE AND WHAT DOESN'T, AND I KNOW BETTER THAN TO PLANT STARFRUIT IN A DRY SPELL.

HOE'S IN THE TOOL SHED BY THE BARN, AND THE CAN. TILL A PATCH OF THE FIELD, PUT A SEED IN IT, WATER IT. WATERED GROUND GROWS FOR TWENTY MINUTES OR SO, THEN IT DRIES. KEEP IT WET AND IT'LL BE READY BEFORE YOU KNOW IT. THE WELL'S BY THE SCARECROW, THE POND'S NEARER THE YARD.

OLD EDDA KEPT IT TILL HER KNEES WENT. SHE LEFT A NOTE ON THE FARMHOUSE DOOR: WORK THE KITCHEN GARDEN AT THE NEAR END FOR FREE, AND THE REST - FIELD, HOUSE AND ALL - IS 500 COINS, FOR HER KNEES. I HOLD THE DEED. THE DOOR STICKS.

ONCE IT'S YOURS? A SHIPPING BIN BY THE MAILBOX - MARLO EMPTIES IT ON HIS ROUND. ORDERS ON THE NOTICE BOARD FROM ALL OVER; THEY PAY BETTER. TAM AND ODILE WILL WORK FOR A WAGE IF YOU'VE MORE FIELD THAN HOURS. AND I SELL SPRINKLERS - SET ONE IN THE FIELD AND THE GROUND ROUND IT NEVER DRIES.
TURNIPS TO LEARN ON - QUICK AND THEY DON'T SULK. STRAWBERRIES KEEP GIVING. PUMPKINS PAY. AND STARFRUIT... WELL. MARLO WILL PAY ANYTHING FOR STARFRUIT, IF YOU'VE THE PATIENCE.
SOMEBODY'S GOAT IS LOOSE AGAIN. AND THE CROWS HAVE TAKEN AGAINST THE SCARECROW'S SHIRT. CAN'T SAY I BLAME THEM.

marlo.name: Marlo Fenn
marlo.role: Produce buyer with a cart, Verdance
marlo.greet: FRESH FACE! FRESH ANYTHING? I BUY, I CART, I SELL IT ON IN TOWN. TURNIPS, PUMPKINS, HONEY, FISH OUT OF THE POND - IF IT GREW OR SWAM ON VERDANCE, I'LL TAKE IT.
marlo.again: BACK! GOOD, GOOD. WHAT'VE YOU GOT?

topics.a: MARLO FENN, CART AND COMPANY. THE COMPANY IS THE CART. I DO THE ROUND OF THE FARMS EVERY DAY AND THE MARKET EVERY NIGHT, AND I SLEEP, OCCASIONALLY, ON THE TURNIPS.
TURNIP 12, CARROT 20, STRAWBERRY 14, SUNFLOWER 32, PUMPKIN 95, AND STARFRUIT - 280, AND I'LL THANK YOU FOR IT. HONEY 25, APPLES 5, POND PERCH 7. A SUN CARP? FORTY-FIVE, AND A STORY TO GO WITH IT.
THE STARFRUIT MAN IS BACK IN TOWN, ASKING WHO'S GROWING. AND THERE'S A GOAT ON THE ROOF OF HOLLIN'S COTTAGE. DON'T TELL HOLLIN.
LET'S HAVE A LOOK, THEN. FAIR PRICES, PAID ON THE SPOT.

ysolde.name: Ysolde Rann
ysolde.greet: NEW BOOTS, NEW FACE. YOU'VE COME FOR THE HOARSPIRE - EVERYONE DOES. START ON THE STAIRCASE AND I'LL TELL YOU IF YOU'RE READY FOR THE REST.

topics.a: BORN IN THAT HUT, CLIMBING BEFORE I COULD WALK - MY MOTHER SAYS I WENT UP THE WOODPILE BEFORE I WENT ACROSS THE FLOOR. I'VE BEEN UP THE HOARSPIRE FORTY-ONE TIMES. THE MOUNTAIN STILL SURPRISES ME.

HOLD TO HOLD. THE ONES IN REACH LIGHT UP - PICK ONE, REACH. LONG REACHES COST YOU, LITTLE CRIMPS COST YOU, HANGING ABOUT COSTS YOU. LEDGES ARE WHERE YOU REST. CHALK DRIES YOUR HANDS. AND CARRY A ROPE: WITH ONE, A FALL TAKES YOU BACK TO THE LAST LEDGE. WITHOUT ONE, ALL THE WAY DOWN.

THE STAIRCASE IS BIG HOLDS AND A FIXED LINE - LEARN ON IT. THE ICEFALL IS ALL ICE, SO YOU'LL WANT AN AXE. THE HOARSPIRE IS THE REAL THING: SMALL HOLDS, LOOSE ROCK, AND A WIND THAT TRIES TO PEEL YOU OFF. HUG A JUG WHEN IT GUSTS.
WITHOUT A PROPER SUIT IT EATS YOU SLOWLY. THE OUTFITTER BY THE SKI HIRE SELLS THERMALS. TOVE'S COCOA BUYS YOU FIVE MINUTES. NEITHER OF THOSE WILL SAVE YOU FROM BEING STUPID.

THERE'S AN OLD BOLT ON THE EAST RIM OF THE SUMMIT AND A ROPE OFF IT, DOWN THE FAR SIDE. PAST THAT, THE LAST RIDGE: A CREVASSE FIELD, A BAND OF SERACS, A HUT, AND A BOWL NOBODY SKIS. KEEP TO THE WANDS. BUY A PROBE OFF ME FIRST - THE SNOW UP THERE LIES, AND IT LIES WELL. I GOT AS FAR AS THE HUT ONCE. THAT'S ALL I'LL SAY.
THERE ARE CRYSTALS IN THE HOARSPIRE'S ROCK THAT GLOW LIKE FROST. OFF THE LINE, MOSTLY - YOU HAVE TO GO OUT OF YOUR WAY. AND SOMEBODY LEFT A REGISTER AT THE TOP. SIGN IT. I'LL CHECK.

tove.name: Tove Lindqvar
tove.greet: YOU LOOK FROZEN. HERE - DON'T ARGUE, DRINK IT. FIRST ONE'S ON THE HOUSE AND EVERY ONE AFTER COSTS SIX.

topics.a: I RAN THE LODGE KITCHEN FOR TWENTY YEARS, THEN I DECIDED I ONLY LIKED MAKING ONE THING. HERE I AM. THE SECRET IS A PINCH OF SALT AND NEVER TELLING ANYONE THE SECRET.
A LODGE, A LIFT, A HANDFUL OF CHALETS AND MORE SKIS THAN PEOPLE. IN THE EVENINGS THE SNOW GOES PINK AND EVERYBODY STOPS WHAT THEY'RE DOING TO LOOK. EVERY EVENING. YOU'D THINK WE'D BE USED TO IT.
ANSGAR SAYS THE COULOIR'S FAST THIS WEEK. ANSGAR SAYS THAT EVERY WEEK. AND THERE'S CHAR UNDER THE POND ICE THE SIZE OF YOUR ARM - BRING ME ONE AND I'LL SMOKE IT FOR YOU. WELL. I'LL BUY IT.
FISH FROM THE POND? I'LL TAKE THEM. CRYSTALS, NO - TAKE THOSE TO SOMEONE WHO KNOWS WHAT THEY'RE FOR.

ansgar.name: Ansgar Holm
ansgar.greet: MM. LIFT'S RUNNING. YOU WANT THE TOP, OR YOU WANT TO SKI? EITHER WAY, KEEP YOUR SKIS UP ON THE CHAIR.

topics.a: THIRTY YEARS ON THIS LIFT. I KNOW EVERY CHAIR BY ITS SQUEAK. NUMBER NINETEEN IS LUCKY. NUMBER TWENTY-THREE IS NOT.

THE NURSERY SLOPE, FOR LEARNING. PINEWOOD, FOR SKIING. THE COULOIR, FOR SHOWING OFF AND BREAKING THINGS. YOU DON'T GO ON THE COULOIR TILL I'VE SEEN YOU COME DOWN PINEWOOD. ARROWS TURN YOU, DOWN TUCKS, UP SLOWS YOU. GO BETWEEN THE FLAGS.
SOMEBODY'S BEEN SIGNING THE SUMMIT REGISTER WHO NEVER TOOK THE LIFT. CLIMBED UP, I SUPPOSE. MM. GOOD FOR THEM.
CRYSTALS? I KNOW A MAN WHO TUNES INSTRUMENTS WITH THEM. MM. I'LL PASS THEM ON.

liv.name: Liv Sandvik
liv.greet: YOU'RE STANDING IN THE FINISH. EITHER YOU'RE TIMING ME OR YOU'RE RACING ME - AND YOU DON'T HAVE A STOPWATCH.

topics.a: ANSGAR'S NIECE. I'VE HELD THE COULOIR RECORD SINCE I WAS SIXTEEN - IT'S IN RED INK IN THE TIMING HUT, GO AND LOOK. I TEACH THE NURSERY SLOPE IN THE MORNINGS SO I CAN RACE IN THE AFTERNOONS.
TUCK ON THE STRAIGHTS, DON'T SKID YOUR TURNS - EVERY TIME YOU THROW YOUR SKIS ACROSS, YOU'RE BRAKING. TAKE THE GATES CLOSE. AND IF YOU SPIN OFF A KICKER, LAND IT CLEAN OR DON'T BOTHER.

THE OLD LOT TALK ABOUT SKIING OFF THE BACK OF THE HOARSPIRE, WHERE THERE AREN'T ANY POLES. ANSGAR SAYS NOBODY WHO WENT LOOKING FOR WHAT'S OUT THERE CAME BACK THE SAME. HE ALSO SAYS THAT ABOUT THE COCOA.

tam.name: Tam Rook
tam.greet: ALL RIGHT? TAM ROOK. I DIG, I CARRY, I WATER. MOSTLY I WATER. IF YOU'VE GOT A FIELD AND NOT ENOUGH HOURS, I'M YOUR MAN.
tam.again: BOSS! THE ROWS ARE WET AND THE CROWS ARE SULKING.

topics.a: GREW UP ON THE NEXT FARM OVER, TILL THE WELL WENT SALT. NOW I WORK EVERYBODY ELSE'S. I DON'T MIND. GROUND'S GROUND.
I KEEP EVERY ROW THAT'S GOT SOMETHING IN IT WATERED, ALL DAY, WHETHER YOU'RE HERE OR OFF IN YOUR SPACESHIP. FORTY A DAY.
MARLO SAYS THE STARFRUIT MAN PAYS DOUBLE IN THE DISTRICT. MARLO SAYS A LOT OF THINGS. ALSO HOLLIN'S GOAT ATE MY HAT.

odile.name: Odile Marsh
odile.greet: ODILE MARSH. FORTY HARVESTS ON THIS VALLEY, AND MY BACK STILL BENDS. YOU'LL BE THE ONE WITH EDDA'S FIELD.

topics.a: I BROUGHT IN EDDA'S CROPS FOR TWENTY YEARS. WHEN HER KNEES WENT, SO DID THE WORK. I'D LIKE TO SEE THAT FIELD FULL AGAIN BEFORE MINE GO.
I BRING IN WHAT'S RIPE - INTO YOUR SHIPPING BIN, FOR MARLO - AND PUT THE SAME BACK IN THE GROUND, IF YOU LEAVE SEED IN THE BOX IN THE BARN. SIXTY A DAY.
PUMPKINS PAY, STRAWBERRIES KEEP GIVING, AND TOVE UP ON THE ICE WORLD WILL TAKE EVERY PUMPKIN YOU'VE GOT. WATCH THE ORDER BOARD.

peddler.name: Wendel Crane
peddler.role: Peddler of oddments, never in one place two days running
peddler.greet: AH. A FACE THAT'S BEEN PLACES. WENDEL CRANE, PEDDLER OF ODDMENTS - CHARMS, CURIOS, THINGS THAT DO WHAT THEY OUGHTN'T. TOMORROW I'LL BE SOMEWHERE ELSE, SO LOOK NOW.
peddler.again: STILL ALIVE, I SEE. GOOD. THE DEAD NEVER BUY ANYTHING.

topics.a: LOOK WITH YOUR HANDS, PAY WITH YOUR COINS.
I'VE WALKED EVERY WORLD THE WAYFARER CAN REACH AND A FEW IT CAN'T. I SELL WHAT I FIND AND I FIND WHAT SELLS. THE HAT WAS A GIFT. THE BEARD WAS AN ACCIDENT.

SO YOU'VE HEARD THE WHISPERS. A LIGHT PAST THE HOARSPIRE, PAST THE LAST RIDGE WHERE THE WIND TURNS BACK. SAILORS SEE IT IN STARS, MINERS HEAR IT IN STONE, STATION CREWS SEW IT ON THEIR PATCHES. THE OLD THINGS PEOPLE LEFT BEHIND EACH KNOW A PIECE OF IT. FIND THEM - A LANTERN OF MINE HELPS - AND YOU'LL KNOW THE WHOLE. WHETHER YOU GO... WELL. THAT'S YOUR BUSINESS.
THE SORCERESS ON MIDNIGHT IS BUYING STARFRUIT. THE PAWNBROKER IN THE DISTRICT IS BUYING ANYTHING THAT GLOWS. AND SOMETHING UP ON THE ICE WORLD HAS BEEN WALKING THE RIDGES AT NIGHT, LEAVING NO TRACKS.

juno.name: Juno Pike
juno.greet: HEY - NEW SKIS? DON'T ANSWER, I CAN TELL. THE PARK'S OPEN. THE DECK'S AT THE TOP, THE TOW'S ON THE RIGHT, THE SCOREBOARD'S RIGHT HERE AND MY NAME'S AT THE TOP OF IT.

topics.a: I GREW UP SKIING THE PISTES WITH LIV. SHE WANTED TO GO FASTER. I WANTED TO GO UP. SO I SHOVELLED THIS LOT INTO SHAPE ONE WINTER, BOLTED SOME RAILS TOGETHER FROM THE OLD LIFT, AND NOW ANSGAR PRETENDS HE DOESN'T WATCH FROM THE TOWER.

OFF A KICKER, SPACE SPINS YOU AND HOLDING DOWN GRABS - LAND IT STRAIGHT. RIDE ONTO A RAIL FROM ITS FOOT, OR DROP ONTO IT, AND YOU SLIDE: THE RAIL TIPS YOU ONE WAY THEN THE OTHER, SO LEAN BACK AGAINST IT. SPACE POPS YOU OFF. STRING TRICKS TOGETHER FAST AND THE JUDGES MULTIPLY THEM. FALL AND THEY FORGET THE LOT.
SEVEN THOUSAND FIVE HUNDRED. ALL FOUR RAILS IN ONE COMBO AND A SEVEN-TWENTY OFF THE BIG ONE. BEAT IT AND I'LL PAY YOU - AND THEN I'LL BEAT YOURS.
LIV SAYS THERE'S A BOWL OFF THE BACK OF THE HOARSPIRE NOBODY'S SKIED IN YEARS. UNTRACKED, ALL THE WAY DOWN. I'D GO, BUT YSOLDE SAYS THE RIDGE BEFORE IT EATS PEOPLE, AND YSOLDE DOESN'T EXAGGERATE.

kiri.name: Kiri Vale
kiri.greet: YOU'RE STANDING STILL ON MY FLOOR. THAT'S THE ONE THING YOU'RE NOT ALLOWED TO DO HERE.
kiri.again: BACK. GOOD. THE FLOOR MISSED YOU.

topics.a: I PLAYED THE ARCADE'S SPEAKERS WHEN I WAS NINE - WIRED A CASSETTE INTO THE HELICOPTER CABINET. NULL GAVE ME THE KEYS TO THIS PLACE WHEN THE LAST OWNER WENT DARK. I DON'T ASK WHERE NULL GETS KEYS.
THE TILES ARE WIRED TO MY KICK DRUM. EVERY ARROW YOU SEE IS A NOTE I'M PLAYING. EASY IS ON THE BEAT. CLUB IS EIGHTHS. VOID IS WHAT I PLAY AT THREE IN THE MORNING. NEW STEPS EVERY NIGHT.
THE CREW OF A SHIP CALLED THE WREN USED TO COME IN HERE BEFORE A LONG HAUL. FIVE OF THEM, ONE BOOTH, ONE ROUND, NEVER DANCED. THEY STOPPED COMING. SOMEONE SAID THEY WENT NORTH.

dez.name: Dez Okoro
dez.greet: WHAT'LL IT BE? THE FIZZ GLOWS. THE ALE DOESN'T. BOTH WORK.

topics.a: TEN YEARS ON THIS SIDE OF THE BAR. I'VE SEEN EVERY KIND OF NIGHT. THE GOOD ONES ALL END THE SAME WAY - SOMEBODY DANCING WHO SWORE THEY NEVER WOULD.
SODA, SOMETHING PURPLE, AND A DROP OF SOMETHING FROM THE CLINIC THAT MAKES IT GLOW. PERFECTLY SAFE. MOSTLY. IT'LL KEEP YOU ON YOUR FEET.
JORO'S BEEN IN TWICE THIS WEEK ASKING IF ANYONE'S SEEN A BLUE CRYSTAL THE SIZE OF A FIST. SAYS IT'S FOR A CLIENT. JORO ALWAYS SAYS IT'S FOR A CLIENT.

mette.name: Mette Rask
mette.greet: BOOTS BY THE FIRE, COCOA'S ON. YOU LOOK FROZEN THROUGH. NEW, ARE YOU? EVERYONE'S NEW ONCE.
mette.again: YOUR CHAIR'S STILL WARM. BARLEY KEPT IT FOR YOU.

topics.a: THIRTY WINTERS BEHIND THIS BAR. I CAME UP FOR ONE SEASON TO SKI AND MARRIED THE LODGE INSTEAD. IT SNORES LESS THAN A HUSBAND AND IT KEEPS ME WARM.

ROOMS UP THE STAIR, FIFTEEN COINS AND I WAKE YOU WITH COFFEE. THE BOARD BY THE STAIR HAS EVERYONE'S TIMES ON IT - LIV'S, YSOLDE'S, YOURS IF YOU'VE GOT ANY. AND DON'T PLAY DICE WITH SIGRUN UNLESS YOU CAN AFFORD IT.
COCOA FOR THE COLD, MULLED CIDER FOR THE SOUL, AND FONDUE IF YOU'VE BEEN OUT ON THE FACE ALL DAY. ALL OF IT KEEPS THE COLD OFF A WHILE. THE CHESTNUTS ARE FOR BARLEY BUT HE'LL SHARE.
OLD BRYN SAYS THERE'S A LIGHT PAST THE HOARSPIRE. HE'S SAID IT EVERY WINTER FOR FORTY YEARS. THE FUNNY THING IS, THIS YEAR YSOLDE'S STARTED SAYING IT TOO.

bryn.name: Old Bryn
bryn.role: Retired guide, at the dice table
bryn.greet: SIT, SIT. THE STOOL'S WARM. YOU'VE THE HANDS OF A CLIMBER, OR YOU WILL HAVE BY THE END OF THE WEEK.
bryn.again: BACK FOR MORE PUNISHMENT? GOOD. THE DICE MISSED YOU.

topics.a: FIFTY YEARS GUIDING ON THESE HILLS. I TAUGHT YSOLDE TO TIE IN WHEN SHE WAS NINE, AND SHE'S BEEN TELLING ME I DO IT WRONG EVER SINCE. MY KNEES RETIRED BEFORE I DID.

FIVE DICE, A CUP, AND A STRAIGHT FACE. FLAKES ARE WILD. YOU BID HOW MANY OF A FACE ARE UNDER ALL THE CUPS - YOURS AND OURS. IF YOU THINK SOMEBODY'S LYING, CALL IT. I DON'T LIE OFTEN. SIGRUN LIES LIKE OTHER PEOPLE BREATHE.

I WAS A BOY WHEN IVO WENT UP THE LAST TIME. HE PUT WANDS ACROSS THE CRACKS ON THE FAR SIDE SO HE COULD FIND HIS WAY HOME. HE NEVER CAME HOME. BUT HIS WANDS ARE STILL THERE, THEY SAY. FOLLOW THE ORANGE RAGS AND YOU WON'T FALL IN.
THERE'S A LIGHT PAST THE HOARSPIRE. NO, DON'T LAUGH. I'VE SEEN IT, ON THE CLEAREST NIGHTS, FROM THE SUMMIT BENCH. A LITTLE GOLD STAR WHERE THERE OUGHT TO BE NOTHING BUT ICE.

sigrun.name: Sigrun
sigrun.role: Keeps the chairlift running, plays dice
sigrun.greet: HE CHEATS. I CHEAT BETTER. YOU'RE WELCOME TO TRY, IF YOU'VE COINS.
sigrun.again: OH, IT'S YOU. SIT. I NEED THE MONEY.

topics.a: I KEEP THE LIFT TURNING. EVERY BOLT ON EVERY PYLON, EVERY MORNING BEFORE ANSGAR LETS ANYONE ON. IF YOU'VE EVER SWUNG IN A CHAIR AND NOT FALLEN OFF THE MOUNTAIN, THAT WAS ME.
BRYN WILL TELL YOU I BLUFF. BRYN IS RIGHT. THE TRICK IS, SOMETIMES I DON'T. WATCH WHAT I BID WHEN I'VE GOT NOTHING TO LOSE - AND THEN DON'T TRUST THAT EITHER.
LIV? SHE'S BEEN FASTEST DOWN THE COULOIR SINCE SHE WAS FOURTEEN. SHE PRETENDS SHE DOESN'T CHECK THE BOARD. SHE CHECKS THE BOARD EVERY NIGHT.
JUNO'S BUILT ANOTHER RAIL DOWN IN THE PARK. KINKED. NOBODY'S RIDDEN IT CLEAN BUT HER. AND SOMEBODY'S BEEN UP THE ICE STEP ON THE LAST RIDGE - THERE ARE FRESH AXE MARKS. NOT ME. I'M NOT MAD.

inge.name: Inge Brask
inge.greet: SKIS? GOGGLES? WAX? ALL THREE. TRUST ME. YOU HAVE THE LOOK OF SOMEONE WHO'S ABOUT TO FALL OVER A LOT.
inge.again: BACK AGAIN. NOTHING BROKEN, I HOPE. ON YOU OR THE SKIS.

topics.a: MY FATHER RAN THIS SHOP, AND HIS FATHER BUILT IT. I'VE WAXED EVERY PAIR OF SKIS IN FELLHAVEN AT LEAST ONCE. LIV'S A HUNDRED TIMES. SHE PRETENDS SHE DOES HER OWN.
A HOT COAT ON THE BASES AND YOU RUN QUICKER, ESPECIALLY ON THE FLATS WHERE EVERYONE ELSE IS POLING. TWENTY MINUTES OF IT, THEN THE SNOW TAKES IT BACK. TEN COINS AT THE BENCH.
NURSERY SLOPE FIRST, NO ARGUMENTS. THEN PINEWOOD. THE COULOIR ONLY ONCE PINEWOOD'S DONE AND YOUR KNEES HAVE STOPPED SHAKING. AND JUNO'S PARK IF YOU WANT TO FLY - SHE BUILT EVERY RAIL HERSELF.
SOMEBODY BOUGHT A PAIR OF TOURING SKINS LAST WEEK AND WOULDN'T SAY WHERE THEY WERE GOING. YSOLDE SAYS THERE'S ONLY ONE PLACE YOU NEED SKINS FOR. PAST THE HOARSPIRE.

bridget.name: Bridget Hale
bridget.role: Bakes at the Crusty Loaf, Brambleford
bridget.greet: YOU'RE THE ONE FROM THE SKIFF! COME IN, COME IN - WELL, YOU ARE IN. THE HONEY CAKES ARE STILL WARM. THEY'RE ALWAYS STILL WARM; THAT'S THE TRICK.
bridget.again: BACK FOR MORE? I KNEW IT. NOBODY ONLY HAS ONE HONEY CAKE.

topics.a: I'VE BAKED FOR BRAMBLEFORD SINCE I COULD SEE OVER THE COUNTER. UP AT FOUR, OVEN LIT BY FIVE, LUDD'S FLOUR, NELL'S HONEY - WELL, NELL'S BEES' HONEY. THE PUMPKIN PIE IS MY MOTHER'S. DON'T ASK FOR THE RECIPE.
SIXTY-ONE OF US AND THE GOAT. EVERYONE KNOWS EVERYONE'S BUSINESS, WHICH SAVES TIME. THE HARVEST SUPPER'S AT THE HAYLOFT - BRING A DISH, OR BRING AN APPETITE AND SIT NEAR ME.

EDDA'S PLACE, DOWN MEADOW LANE. SHE KEPT IT LOVELY - BEES, HENS, THE LOT. IT'S SAT EMPTY TOO LONG. IF YOU'RE THINKING WHAT I THINK YOU'RE THINKING, HOLLIN LIVES NEXT DOOR TO IT. HE'LL TALK YOU THROUGH IT.

percy.name: Percy Pennyworth
percy.greet: GOOD AFTERNOON, GOOD AFTERNOON. PENNYWORTH'S: SEEDS, SUNDRIES, AND ANYTHING ELSE IF YOU GIVE ME A WEEK. MY GRANDFATHER'S SIGN, MY GRANDFATHER'S SCALES. MY PRICES, I'M AFRAID.
percy.again: AH, A REGULAR. I KEEP A LITTLE BOOK OF REGULARS. YOU ARE NOW IN IT.

topics.a: THREE GENERATIONS OF PENNYWORTHS BEHIND THIS COUNTER. I'M THE FIRST ONE WHO CAN WORK THE TILL WITHOUT KICKING IT.
TURNIPS IF YOU'RE IMPATIENT, PUMPKINS IF YOU'RE NOT, STARFRUIT IF YOU'RE RICH. EVERYTHING GROWS QUICKER IN ITS SEASON - THE CHAPEL CALENDAR SAYS WHICH.
THE PEDDLER COMES THROUGH NOW AND THEN AND SETS UP ON THE SQUARE. SELLS THINGS THAT DO THINGS. I DON'T STOCK THINGS THAT DO THINGS. I STOCK THINGS.

wat.name: Wat Coldridge
wat.greet: MIND THE HEARTH. SHOES, HINGES, TOOLS - IF IT'S IRON I'LL MEND IT OR MAKE IT. HORSESHOES FOR LUCK, IF YOU'RE THAT SORT.
wat.again: STILL GOT ALL YOUR FINGERS? GOOD. KEEP IT THAT WAY.

topics.a: MY HANDS ARE MY FATHER'S HANDS. MY TEMPER IS MY MOTHER'S. THE FORGE HAS BEEN LIT ON THIS SPOT FOR A HUNDRED AND TWELVE YEARS, AND I'M NOT GOING TO BE THE ONE THAT LETS IT GO OUT.
HANG IT POINTS UP AND THE LUCK STAYS IN. CARRY IT AND THE FISH BITE SOONER - DON'T ASK ME WHY, ASK THE FISH. LUDD SWEARS BY HIS.
BRING ME ORE FROM THAT MINE ON LUMAR AND I'LL TELL YOU IF IT'S ANY GOOD. MOSTLY IT ISN'T. NOW AND THEN IT SINGS.

ludd.name: Old Ludd
ludd.greet: EH? OH - THE SKY-FARMER. WELCOME, WELCOME. MIND THE SACKS. MIND THE WHEEL. MIND THE GOOSE, MOSTLY.
ludd.again: BACK AGAIN. THE WHEEL'S STILL TURNING. IT ALWAYS IS. THAT'S THE POINT OF IT.

topics.a: SIXTY YEARS AT THIS MILL. I'VE HEARD THAT WHEEL GO ROUND MORE TIMES THAN THERE ARE STARS, AND I COULDN'T SLEEP WITHOUT IT NOW.

EDDA'S. SHE BROUGHT ME THE FIRST GRAIN EVERY YEAR AND I GROUND IT FOR NOTHING, FOR LUCK. SHE ALWAYS SAID SHE'D GO NORTH ONE DAY, OVER THE HILLS. SHE NEVER WENT. LEFT HER THIMBLE BY THE WINDMILL, THEY SAY.
COMES DOWN FROM THE HILLS COLD AS A COIN. THERE'S PERCH IN THE FARM POND THAT CAME DOWN IT AS EGGS. DON'T TELL NELL I SAID SO, SHE THINKS THEY'RE HERS.

nell.name: Nell Ashby
nell.role: Keeps the flower stall on the square
nell.greet: HELLO! A POSY? FOR SOMEONE SPECIAL, OR FOR YOU? BOTH ARE ALLOWED. NAN SAYS EVERYONE SHOULD HAVE FLOWERS AT LEAST ONCE A WEEK.
nell.again: YOU AGAIN! I'VE KEPT YOU THE BEST SUNFLOWER. DON'T TELL PERCY.

topics.a: NAN GROWS THEM OVER THE BRIDGE, I SELL THEM ON THE SQUARE, THE BEES DO MOST OF THE WORK. NAN'S COTTAGE IS THE ONE WITH THE APPLE TREES.
EVERYONE HAS SOMETHING THEY LOVE. BRIDGET LOVES HONEY. WAT PRETENDS HE DOESN'T LIKE FLOWERS BUT HE KEEPS THE LAST ONE I GAVE HIM IN A JAR ON THE ANVIL. LUDD LOVES A GOOD PUMPKIN.
NOBODY KNOWS WHOSE IT IS. IT TURNS UP, EATS SOMETHING IMPORTANT, AND LEAVES. WE PUT UP NOTICES. IT EATS THE NOTICES.

mags.name: Mags Tolley
mags.greet: WELL, LOOK WHAT THE SKY DRAGGED IN. COME IN OUT OF THE SUN. CIDER'S COLD, STEW'S HOT, AND THE GOSSIP'S FREE IF YOU SIT LONG ENOUGH.
mags.again: BACK AGAIN? YOUR STOOL'S STILL WARM. NOBODY ELSE WANTED IT - IT WOBBLES.

topics.a: THE HAYLOFT WAS MY DAD'S, AND HIS MUM'S BEFORE. THE THATCH IS OLDER THAN ALL OF US. ONCE A YEAR WE GET UP ON THE ROOF AND ARGUE ABOUT WHETHER IT NEEDS DOING. IT ALWAYS DOES.
PERCY'S SWEET ON BRIDGET AND THINKS NOBODY KNOWS. WAT KEEPS ONE OF NELL'S FLOWERS IN A JAR AND THINKS NOBODY KNOWS. EVERYBODY KNOWS EVERYTHING. THAT'S BRAMBLEFORD.
FIRST NIGHT OF AUTUMN, THE WHOLE VILLAGE IN HERE AND SPILLING OUT ONTO THE SQUARE. BRING SOMETHING YOU GREW. THE BEST PUMPKIN GETS HUNG OVER THE DOOR TILL IT FALLS ON SOMEBODY.

bess.name: Bess Tolliver
bess.role: Harbourmistress of Diggen's Point, and of Tolliver & Daughters' slip
bess.greet: TOLLIVER. I KEEP THE BOOK FOR EVERY KEEL THAT TIES UP HERE, AND MY GIRLS BUILD CUTTERS ON THE SLIP BEHIND THE FISH SHEDS. YOU'LL BE THE ONE WITH THE LITTLE GULL.
bess.again: BACK AGAIN. THE GULL'S WHERE YOU LEFT HER - SHE ALWAYS IS.

topics.a: HERE. EVERYTHING OF YOURS THAT FLOATS, EVERYTHING I CAN SELL YOU THAT DOES, AND WHO'S LOOKING FOR A BERTH.
TOLLIVER & DAUGHTERS. THREE GIRLS, ONE SLIP, A CUTTER EVERY SIX WEEKS. A CUTTER'S THE QUICKEST THING ON THE EMERALD AND SHE'LL CARRY FORTY CRATES. ONE HAND TO SAIL HER - SIGN SOMEBODY ON.

SALT FISH, LAMP OIL AND PINE ARE CHEAP HERE - WE MAKE THEM. SAPPHIRE PAYS WELL FOR TIMBER, CRIMSON FOR ANYTHING THAT ISN'T RUM. BUY WHERE IT'S MADE, SELL WHERE IT'S WANTED. THE CONTRACTS PAY BEST OF ALL.

NOT MANY ON THE EMERALD - THE SAPPHIRE GUARD SEES TO THAT. MORE ON THE OTHER SEAS, AND THE CRIMSON'S THICK WITH THEM. THEY'LL WANT YOUR CARGO. PAY THEM, FIGHT THEM OR RUN. A SLOOP WITH NO GUNS HAD BETTER RUN.

THERE'S STARLING HOLM, OUT PAST TERN HOLM ON THE WAY TO THE CAPITAL. A COTTAGE GONE TO RUIN, A JETTY, A WALLED GARDEN UNDER BRAMBLES. THE PRICE IS ON THE SIGN AT THE JETTY. MAKE IT A HOME PORT - YOUR SHIPS CAN TRADE FROM IT WHILE YOU'RE BUSY.

aldous.name: Aldous Penhallow
aldous.role: Harbourmaster of Sapphire Port and master of the Great Yard
aldous.greet: PENHALLOW, HARBOURMASTER. THE GREAT YARD IS MINE AS WELL - BRIGANTINES, AND WHEN SOMEBODY CAN AFFORD ONE, A GALLEON. SAPPHIRE PORT IS WHERE THE SEAS COME TO TRADE.
aldous.again: AH. WELCOME BACK TO THE BUSIEST QUAY ON LUMAR.

topics.a: THE BOOK. SHIPS, THE YARD, GUNS, HANDS, THE HOLD, THE MARKET. WE DO IT ALL HERE, AND WE DO IT PROPERLY.

A BRIGANTINE TAKES THREE HANDS AND CARRIES A HUNDRED AND TWENTY CRATES - SHE'LL RIDE OUT A CRIMSON SQUALL THAT WOULD SINK YOUR SLOOP. THE GALLEON TAKES FIVE AND CARRIES A WAREHOUSE. NEITHER POINTS WELL. NOTHING THAT BIG DOES.

OUR GLASS IS CHEAP - THE KILNS NEVER STOP. WE PAY DEARLY FOR TIMBER, SPORE SILK AND ROSEITE: EVERY HULL ON THE SLIP WANTS ROSEITE. AND MOON SALT... IF YOU CAN STOMACH THE MIDNIGHT SEA, BRING ME MOON SALT.

SWIVELS, LONG NINES, CARRONADES. A LONG NINE REACHES; A CARRONADE SMASHES BUT ONLY CLOSE. GUNS FIRE ABEAM - PUT THE ENEMY ON YOUR SIDE, NOT YOUR BOW. AND A GUN WITH A GUNNER ON IT FIRES TWICE AS OFTEN.

mira.name: Mira Quell
mira.role: Keeps Rose Cove's harbour book and weaves crystal sailcloth
mira.greet: MIRA QUELL. I KEEP THE COVE'S BOOK, AND IN THE EVENINGS I WEAVE. SPORE SILK WITH CRYSTAL IN THE WARP - SAILS THAT SING WHEN THE WIND'S RIGHT.
mira.again: THE COVE'S GLAD OF YOU. SO AM I.

topics.a: THE COVE'S BOOK. NO YARD HERE - BUT NOBODY ON FIVE SEAS MAKES SAILS LIKE OURS, OR GROWS ROSEITE ONTO A HULL.
CRYSTAL-WEAVE SAILS. QUICKER ON EVERY POINT, AND SHE'LL POINT HIGHER INTO THE WIND THAN SHE HAS ANY RIGHT TO. A BIG SQUARE-RIGGER CAN'T POINT FOR WANT OF TRYING - THESE HELP.
WE GROW IT ON. A DROP OF WATER AND ROSEITE GOES HARD AS GLASS, SO WE PAINT IT ON HER BILGES AND LET THE SEA DO THE REST. ROCKS AND REEFS DO HALF THE HARM. MIDNIGHT'S ROCKS ESPECIALLY.
SILK AND ROSEITE ARE CHEAP - THEY'RE OURS. WE'RE SHORT OF SALT FISH, TIMBER AND GLASS. AND THE COVE'S NAVIGATORS READ THE SPORE CURRENTS LIKE PRINT: SIGN ONE ON.

garro.name: Garro
garro.role: Quartermaster of the pirate beach on Crimson Reach. One eye, no questions
garro.greet: GARRO. I RUN THIS BEACH FOR PEOPLE WHO DON'T LIKE THEIR NAMES IN BOOKS. I KEEP ONE ANYWAY. YOU WANT A SHIP THAT CAN OUTRUN ANYTHING, OR GUNS THAT CAN STOP IT - I'VE GOT BOTH.
garro.again: STILL AFLOAT. THE SQUALLS DIDN'T HAVE YOU, THEN.

topics.a: MY BOOK. THE RAIDER ON THE SLIP, THE HEAVY GUNS, STORM RIGGING, AND PEOPLE WHO KNOW HOW TO FIGHT. NO QUESTIONS.
BLACK HULL, TWO MASTS, FOUR GUN PORTS. FASTEST THING ON THE FIVE SEAS. THREE HANDS TO SAIL HER. DON'T ASK WHO HAD HER BEFORE.

THE CRIMSON SEA DOESN'T NEED PIRATES TO KILL YOU. THE SQUALLS COME IN EVERY FEW MINUTES - LIGHTNING, GREEN WATER OVER THE RAIL. A SMALL BOAT GETS BEATEN TO KINDLING. STORM RIGGING, A BIG HULL, A GOOD RIGGER - OR STAY HOME.

MY OLD FRIENDS. THEY'LL HAIL YOU: PAY AND THEY'LL LET YOU BY, MOSTLY. FIGHT AND THEY'LL TRY TO BOARD - HAVE FIGHTERS ABOARD. RUN, IF YOU'RE QUICKER THAN THEM. EMBER RUM AND BLACK POWDER ARE CHEAP HERE, BY THE WAY. EVERYTHING ELSE IS DEAR.

ferryman.name: The Ferryman
ferryman.role: Rows the dead no longer. Sells moon salt and moonglass to the living
ferryman.greet: ...YOU CAME BY SEA. FEW DO. I FERRIED THE DROWNED ACROSS THE MOON POOL FOR LONGER THAN THE ABBEY STOOD. NOW I KEEP THE PIER, AND SELL THE LIVING WHAT THEY CAME FOR.

topics.a: MY LEDGER IS OLDER THAN MOST SHIPS. MOON SALT, MOONGLASS, AND THOSE OF THE DROWNED WHO WOULD SAIL AGAIN.

THE ROCKS COME OUT OF THE MIST WITHOUT WARNING. AND THERE ARE THINGS IN THE WATER THAT WERE SAILORS ONCE. A MOON LANTERN AT YOUR MASTHEAD KEEPS THEM OFF AND SHOWS THE ROCKS. A MOONGLASS HARPOON SENDS THEM HOME.
RAKED FROM THE FLATS ROUND THE MOON POOL. IT GLOWS. ALCHEMISTS ON EVERY ISLAND WILL PAY YOU TEN TIMES WHAT I ASK - IF YOU LIVE TO SELL IT. I SELL A LITTLE EACH DAY. NO MORE.
SOME OF THEM REMEMBER THE SEA FONDLY. THEY DON'T EAT, THEY DON'T SLEEP AND THEY DON'T FEAR BOARDERS. SIGN ONE ON, IF YOU CAN BEAR THE COLD OF THEM.

rowena.name: Rowena Ashgrove
rowena.role: Harbourmistress of Crownhaven, keeper of the Crown's book of keels
rowena.greet: ASHGROVE. EVERY SHIP THAT COMES INTO THE CAPITAL IS WRITTEN IN MY BOOK, AND THE ROYAL YARD BUILDS TO MY ORDERS. YOU WANT A GALLEON? THIS IS THE ONLY PLACE ON FIVE SEAS THAT CAN BUILD YOU ONE.
rowena.again: BACK IN THE CAPITAL. THE BOOK'S OPEN.

topics.a: THE CROWN'S BOOK. THE ROYAL YARD, GUNS, HANDS FROM EVERY SEA - THEY ALL COME TO THE CAPITAL - THE HOLD, THE MARKET, CONTRACTS.
CUTTERS, BRIGANTINES, AND THE GALLEON - THREE MASTS, THREE HUNDRED CRATES, FIVE GUNS, FIVE HANDS TO SAIL HER. SHE'LL TAKE A WHILE TO GET USED TO. EVERYONE SAYS SO.
EVERYTHING SELLS IN THE CAPITAL, AND THE LUXURIES BEST OF ALL: SPORE SILK, ROSEITE, GEMS OUT OF THE ROSE MINE, AND MOON SALT IF YOU'RE BRAVE. THE EXCHANGE BOARD SAYS WHAT'S UP TODAY.

FUNNY YOU SHOULD ASK. STARLING HOLM, SOUTH-EAST OF HERE - A LITTLE ISLAND WITH A JETTY AND A COTTAGE GONE TO RUIN. THE LAST OWNER WENT TO SEA AND DIDN'T COME BACK. THE SIGN ON THE JETTY HAS THE PRICE. BUILD IT UP AND IT'LL BE A HOME PORT FOR YOUR SHIPS.

maud.name: Maud Tull
maud.greet: FRESH TODAY, ALL OF IT. WELL. MOST OF IT. WHAT'VE YOU CAUGHT? I'LL BUY IT IF IT'S GOOD.
maud.again: BACK FOR MORE? I'VE GOT CRAB.

topics.a: LET'S SEE IT, THEN.
MY HUSBAND FISHES, MY SONS FISH, MY DAUGHTER FISHES AND I SELL IT. IF YOU STAND STILL LONG ENOUGH I'LL SELL YOU TOO.

tern_pell.name: Old Pell
tern_pell.role: Keeps Tern Holm's pier, and its stories
tern_pell.greet: PELL. I KEEP THE PIER. IT DOESN'T NEED MUCH KEEPING, BUT SOMEBODY HAS TO WATCH THE BOATS COME IN. YOU'LL WANT THE FISH, I EXPECT. EVERYBODY DOES.
tern_pell.again: AYE. THE TERNS TOLD ME YOU WERE COMING.

topics.a: MY BOOK'S A SHORT ONE. A SWIVEL GUN IF YOU WANT ONE, SALT FISH CHEAP AS ANYWHERE, AND LADS WHO CAN HAUL A ROPE.
TWENTY HOUSES, FORTY BOATS, A THOUSAND TERNS. WE SALT THE FISH AND THE CAPITAL EATS IT. THAT'S TERN HOLM.
THE PIRATES DON'T BOTHER US - NOTHING HERE BUT FISH. BUT A BOAT CAME IN LAST WEEK FROM THE MIDNIGHT SIDE WITH HER SAILS ALL FROSTED, IN SUMMER. NOBODY ABOARD WOULD SAY WHY.
STARLING HOLM? NICE LITTLE PLACE ONCE. THE COTTAGE IS A SHELL NOW. SOMEBODY OUGHT TO TAKE IT ON.

crown_guard.name: Sergeant Hale
crown_guard.role: Guard at the palace gate, Crownhaven
crown_guard.greet: MOVE ALONG. THE QUEEN-REGENT SEES CAPTAINS OF FLEETS - THREE SHIPS OR MORE. THE REST OF YOU, THE GATE'S SHUT.
crown_guard.again: STILL HERE? THE GATE'S STILL SHUT.

topics.a: THREE SHIPS UNDER YOUR NAME, CAPTAIN. BUY THEM AT THE YARDS - ROWENA'S ON THE QUAY BUILDS UP TO A GALLEON. COME BACK WITH THREE AND THE GATE OPENS. SHE'S ALWAYS LOOKING FOR CAPTAINS. THE GOOD ONES DON'T STAY LONG ON THE QUAY.
SHE RULES FOR THE YOUNG KING TILL HE'S OF AGE. KEEPS THE SAPPHIRE GUARD ON THE EMERALD, WHICH IS WHY YOU DON'T SEE MANY PIRATES HERE. SEES MERCHANTS SOMETIMES. BIG ONES. WITH FLEETS.
OFF THE RECORD? THERE'S TALK OF A SIXTH SEA, PAST THE MIDNIGHT. THE PALACE SENT A SHIP TO LOOK. IT HASN'T COME BACK. DON'T TELL ANYONE I SAID SO.

wright.name: Agnes Rook
wright.role: Master shipwright of the Royal Yard
wright.greet: ROOK. I BUILD THE GALLEONS. THAT ONE ON THE STOCKS HAS TAKEN SEVEN MONTHS AND SHE'S NOT HALF DONE. YOU WANT ONE, THE HARBOURMISTRESS TAKES THE ORDERS.

topics.a: A CUTTER'S A FORE-AND-AFTER: POINTS HIGH, TURNS QUICK. A BRIGANTINE'S SQUARE SAILS FORWARD - SHE RUNS BEAUTIFULLY BEFORE THE WIND AND HATES BEATING INTO IT. A GALLEON'S ALL SQUARE: SET HER ON A BROAD REACH AND STAY THERE. EASE THE SHEET AND THE YARDS SQUARE AWAY; HAUL IT AND THEY BRACE ROUND.
MORE PORTS, MORE GUNS. A CUTTER TAKES ONE, A GALLEON FIVE. GUNS FIRE ABEAM - SO SAIL ALONGSIDE, DON'T CHASE. AND PUT A GUNNER ON EACH, OR THEY'RE SLOW AS SUNDAY.
EVERY KNOCK COSTS. ROCKS, SQUALLS, PIRATE SHOT. ANY HARBOURMASTER CAN PATCH HER, AND IF YOU'VE A DOCK OF YOUR OWN, YOU CAN DO IT THERE.

hetty.name: Hetty Marsh
hetty.greet: WHAT'LL IT BE, CAPTAIN? ALE'S COLD, STEW'S HOT, AND THE COMPANY'S NO WORSE THAN USUAL.
hetty.again: BACK AGAIN? YOUR STOOL'S WHERE YOU LEFT IT.

topics.a: MY GRAN'S PUB, THEN MY MUM'S, NOW MINE. EVERY CREW THAT PUTS IN AT THE CAPITAL DRINKS HERE SOONER OR LATER. THE ANCHOR OVER THE FIRE'S FROM THE FIRST SHIP THE ROYAL YARD EVER BUILT. OR SO I TELL THEM.
THE LANDLADY? OFF THE SOVEREIGN, THAT WENT DOWN OFF THE TEETH WITH THE CROWN'S PAYROLL. SHE WASHED UP ON THE QUAY ONE MORNING, CROWN AND ALL. NOBODY'S EVER SAID WHERE THE GOLD WENT.
ASK THE BOSUN BY THE DOOR. HE KEEPS THE LIST OF EVERY HAND IN PORT WHO WANTS A BERTH. SOBER ONES ARE MARKED WITH A STAR.

ANNIE SAYS THERE'S A SIXTH SEA PAST THE CRIMSON. JOSS SAYS ANNIE'S BEEN AT THE GROG. THE ONE WHO'S NEVER WRONG IS TAMSIN UP AT SAPPHIRE'S LIGHT - AND SHE'S BEEN SIGNALLING SOMETHING OUT TOWARD MIDNIGHT EVERY NIGHT FOR A MONTH.

annie.name: Salt Annie
annie.role: Sailor, forty years before the mast
annie.greet: SIT DOWN, CAPTAIN, BEFORE JOSS TAKES THE STOOL FOR HIS FEET. YOU PLAY BONES?
annie.again: AH, THE CAPTAIN. COME TO LOSE A LITTLE MORE?

topics.a: SAILED EVERY SEA THERE IS, AND ONE THERE ISN'T. BOSUN ON THE ASHGROVE TILL SHE WENT DOWN. NOW I PLAY BONES AND TELL LIES TO YOUNG CAPTAINS. THE LIES ARE FREE.

PAST THE CRIMSON, WHERE THE SQUALLS STOP ALL AT ONCE AND THE WATER GOES STILL AS A MIRROR. WE SAW IT ONE DAWN ON THE ASHGROVE. THE CAPTAIN TURNED HER ROUND AND NEVER SPOKE OF IT. NOBODY BELIEVES ME. GOOD.
IN A CRIMSON SQUALL, EASE YOUR SHEET BEFORE IT HITS, NOT AFTER. IN THE MIDNIGHT, BUY THE FERRYMAN'S LANTERN AND DON'T ARGUE ABOUT THE PRICE. AND NEVER PLAY BONES WITH JOSS WHEN HE'S SMILING.

joss.name: Cutter Joss
joss.greet: BONES IS HONEST. IT'S THE PLAYERS YOU WATCH.
joss.again: BACK FOR YOUR COINS? THEY'RE IN MY POCKET. COME AND GET THEM.

topics.a: SAILED WITH GARRO'S LOT ON THE CRIMSON, FIVE YEARS. RAN THE BOARDING PARTY. THEN I GOT OLD AND HONEST, IN THAT ORDER. MOSTLY HONEST.

THEY HAIL YOU FIRST, ALWAYS - NOBODY WANTS A FIGHT IF A PURSE WILL DO. PAY IF YOU'RE LIGHT. RUN IF YOU'RE QUICK. IF YOU FIGHT, KEEP THEM ON YOUR BEAM WHERE YOUR GUNS ARE, AND KEEP FIGHTERS ABOARD, OR THEY'LL BE ON YOUR DECK BEFORE YOUR SECOND BROADSIDE.
OFF THE SOVEREIGN'S PAYROLL. JOKING. PROBABLY.

bosun.name: Bosun Teague
bosun.role: Keeps the list of hands in port
bosun.greet: HANDS LOOKING FOR A BERTH, CAPTAIN. GOOD ONES GO QUICK.
bosun.again: THE LIST CHANGES EVERY DAY. LOOK WHILE IT'S FRESH.

topics.a: A GUNNER DOUBLES HOW FAST A GUN RELOADS. A NAVIGATOR GETS YOU THERE QUICKER. A RIGGER KEEPS YOUR CANVAS ON IN A BLOW. FIGHTERS FOR BOARDING, A PURSER FOR THE PRICES. AND DECKHANDS - EVERY SHIP NEEDS HER DECKHANDS.
THIRTY YEARS A BOSUN. MY KNEES GAVE UP BEFORE I DID. NOW I SIT HERE AND PUT GOOD HANDS ON GOOD SHIPS, AND THE CAPTAINS STAND ME A PINT.

registrar.name: Ambrose Vane
registrar.greet: CHARTERS ARE FOR CAPTAINS WITH HOLDS, NOT POCKETS. WHAT ARE YOU SAILING?
registrar.again: AH. THE CAPTAIN. THE CHARTER BOOK IS OPEN.

topics.a: A LONG HAUL. SO MANY CRATES OF A GOOD TO A PORT, BY A DAY. YOU FIND THE GOODS, YOU CARRY THEM, THE HARBOURMASTER THERE PAYS ON SIGHT. THE BIG ONES ONLY A GALLEON CAN TAKE, AND THEY PAY ACCORDINGLY.
EVERY PRICE ON THE FIVE SEAS IS SETTLED IN THIS HALL BEFORE NOON. THE BOARD IS CHALKED FRESH EVERY DAY. THE RING IS WHERE THE BROKERS SHOUT. I DO NOT SHOUT. I WRITE.
BUY WHERE A THING IS MADE. SELL WHERE IT IS WANTED. DO NOT SELL A WHOLE HOLD OF ANYTHING IN ONE PORT - THE PRICE FALLS WITH EVERY CRATE. THE BOARD SHOWS THE DAY'S BEST RUNS, IF YOU CAN READ.

quill.name: Tobias Quill
quill.greet: SALT FISH UP TWO AT SAPPHIRE. GLASS DOWN AT ROSE. NOBODY WANTS RUM BUT EVERYBODY BUYS IT.
quill.again: THE NUMBERS HAVE MOVED SINCE YOU WERE LAST HERE. THEY ALWAYS DO.

topics.a: I COPY THE PRICES FROM THE RING ONTO THE BOARD AND FROM THE BOARD INTO THE BOOK AND FROM THE BOOK INTO THE OTHER BOOK. ON SUNDAYS I DO SUMS FOR PLEASURE.
THE MOON SALT. NOBODY BUT THE FERRYMAN SELLS IT AND EVERYBODY WANTS IT. IF YOU CAN STAND THE MIDNIGHT SEA, IT'S THE BEST MONEY ON THE BOARD.

wynn.name: Wynn Abbot
wynn.greet: NAME OF VESSEL? TONNAGE? NEXT OF KIN?
wynn.again: YOUR SHIPS ARE ALL IN THE BOOK, CAPTAIN. I CHECKED. TWICE.

topics.a: EVERY KEEL ON THE FIVE SEAS IS ENTERED IN THE GREAT BOOK: HER NAME, HER MASTER, WHERE SHE LIES. YOURS TOO. ASK AT THE WINDOW AND I'LL READ YOU YOUR OWN.
CRATES NOBODY CAME BACK FOR. THE HERON'S PICKLED EELS HAVE BEEN HERE NINE YEARS. I DO NOT OPEN THEM.

pim.name: Pim Sorrel
pim.greet: EVERY SOUNDING TAKEN BY SOMEBODY BRAVER THAN ME.
pim.again: MORE CHARTS? I LOVE A CAPTAIN WHO READS.

topics.a: THE EMERALD YOU KNOW - EVERYONE DOES. THE OTHER FOUR I SELL BY THE SEA: EVERY ISLAND, EVERY HARBOUR MOUTH, EVERY ROCK WE KNOW OF. ONCE A SEA'S ON YOUR CHART YOU CAN SET A COURSE FOR ANYWHERE IN IT. THE CHART WINDOW, CAPTAIN.
ILSA? WE TRADE SOUNDINGS. SHE DRAWS PRETTIER COASTS; I DRAW MORE ACCURATE ROCKS. BETWEEN US NOBODY SHOULD EVER RUN AGROUND. THEY DO ANYWAY.
THE OTHER SIDE SAYS UNSURVEYED. I WROTE THAT. ONE DAY SOMEBODY WILL MAKE ME CROSS IT OUT.

coralie.name: Mother Coralie
coralie.greet: SIT A WHILE IF YOU LIKE. THE SEA WILL STILL BE THERE.
coralie.again: WELCOME BACK. YOU CAME HOME, THEN. I'M GLAD.

topics.a: ONE FOR EVERY CREW STILL OUT. LIGHT ONE GOING OUT YOURSELF AND THE SEA REMEMBERS IT - THE SQUALLS AND THE ROCKS GO EASIER, AND THE PIRATES FIND SOMEBODY ELSE TO BOTHER. SO THE SAILORS SAY. I ONLY KEEP THE CANDLES.
SOMEONE WROTE 'NOT LOST. NOT YET.' UNDER HER NAME ON THE BOARD. I LEFT IT. IF THEY'RE OUT THERE, SOMEONE WILL FIND THEM, AND IT WON'T BE ME, SO I PRAY FOR WHOEVER IT IS.
THE MERRY KESTREL'S CREW HUNG HER THERE, THE YEAR THEY CAME HOME AFTER EVERYONE HAD STOPPED LIGHTING CANDLES FOR THEM. SHE TURNS WHEN THE DOOR OPENS. LIKE SHE'S LOOKING FOR THE NEXT ONES.

steward.name: Lord Steward Bellamy
steward.greet: THE QUEEN-REGENT WILL HEAR YOU. KEEP IT SHORT AND DO NOT MENTION THE PAYROLL.

topics.a: THE SOVEREIGN WENT DOWN OFF THE TEETH WITH THE CROWN'S PAYROLL ABOARD. A YEAR'S WAGES FOR EVERY SAILOR IN THE ROYAL YARD. THE QUEEN-REGENT HAS NOT FORGIVEN THE SEA. WE DO NOT MENTION IT.

SHE RULES FOR THE YOUNG KING TILL HE'S OF AGE. SHE WAS A CAPTAIN HERSELF BEFORE SHE WAS A QUEEN - A FRIGATE, ON THE SAPPHIRE. SHE STILL KEEPS HER CUTLASS UNDER THE THRONE. I HAVE SEEN HER USE IT ON A PETITIONER. FIGURATIVELY. MOSTLY.
HER MAJESTY GIVES THEM TO CAPTAINS SHE TRUSTS, ONE AT A TIME. EACH ONE DONE IS A FAVOUR OWED - A WARRANT, A LETTER UNDER THE GREAT SEAL. THE ADMIRALTY TABLE SHOWS WHERE YOU STAND. BOW FIRST.

bryony.name: Bryony Kettle
bryony.greet: SIT DOWN BEFORE YOU FALL DOWN. STEW'S ON. IT'S ALWAYS ON.
bryony.again: BACK FOR SECONDS? EVERYONE COMES BACK FOR SECONDS.

topics.a: MY GREAT-GRAN STARTED IT THE WINTER THE CAPITAL WAS STILL A FISHING VILLAGE LIKE THIS ONE. NOBODY'S LET IT GO OUT SINCE. YOU ADD WHAT THE BOATS BRING IN. TODAY IT'S MOSTLY CRAB. TOMORROW, WHO KNOWS.
FORTY SOULS, TWELVE BOATS, ONE CHAPEL, ONE INN. WE SELL THE CAPITAL ITS FISH AND THE CAPITAL SELLS US EVERYTHING ELSE. SALT FISH IS CHEAPER HERE THAN ANYWHERE ON THE SEAS - ASK OLD PELL ON THE PIER.

THE FISHERMEN SAY THE TERNS STOPPED FLYING SOUTH-EAST LAST SPRING, TOWARD MIDNIGHT. BIRDS KNOW THINGS. AND SOMEBODY BOUGHT THE OLD HOLM OFF STARLING - OR WILL, IF THEY'VE ANY SENSE. LOVELY LITTLE COTTAGE ONCE.

liesl.name: Liesl Marrow
liesl.role: Keeper of the Glasshouse, Rose Cove
liesl.greet: MIND WHERE YOU STEP. THAT ONE'S THREE DAYS OLD.
liesl.again: BACK TO SEE MY BABIES? THE BIG ONES HAVE BEEN GRUMPY ALL WEEK.

topics.a: A SEED-CRYSTAL THE SIZE OF A LENTIL, A BED OF GRIT, A DROP OF WATER A DAY. NO MORE. MORE AND IT GROWS INTO THE BED, THEN THE FLOOR, THEN THE FOUNDATIONS. THE RIPE ONES IN THE MIDDLE BEDS ARE READY TO PICK - HELP YOURSELF, THEY GROW BACK.
FORTY YEARS OLD, SOME OF THEM. THEY HUM WHEN THE TIDE COMES IN. SING NEAR THEM AND THEY SING BACK, AND THEN THEY DON'T STOP FOR A WEEK. HENCE THE SIGN. HENCE MY EARS.

THE SAILMAKERS WEAVE SEED-CRYSTAL INTO THE CANVAS. LIGHTER, STIFFER, POINTS HIGHER INTO THE WIND. MIRA ON THE PIER FITS THEM. EXPENSIVE. WORTH IT, IF YOU SAIL TO WINDWARD MUCH, AND EVERYONE DOES IN THE END.

alyssa.name: Queen Alyssa
alyssa.role: Queen of the wood elves, Elderglade
alyssa.greet: RISE, TRAVELLER FROM THE STARS. THE WOOD TOLD ME YOU WERE COMING. IT TELLS ME MOST THINGS, EVENTUALLY. WELCOME TO ELDERGLADE.
alyssa.again: AH, OUR TRAVELLER AGAIN. THE TREE LIKES YOU, I THINK. SO DO I.

topics.a: I HAVE KEPT THIS WOOD SINCE THE OLD QUEEN WENT INTO THE WEST. THE ELVES ASK ME FOR JUDGEMENTS, THE TREES ASK ME FOR NOTHING, AND BECKOLAS ASKS ME TO PLEASE STOP WALKING IN THE WOOD WITHOUT HIM. ALL THREE ARE RIGHT, IN THEIR WAY.

MY FIRST SWORD. HE SWORE HIS OATH AT THE MOONWELL WITH HALF THE WOOD WATCHING, AND HE HAS NOT BEEN MORE THAN A STEP FROM MY RIGHT HAND SINCE. HE THINKS I DON'T NOTICE HOW OFTEN HE LOOKS OVER AT ME. I NOTICE.

THERE IS ONE THING, AND QUIETLY. I TIED A RIBBON TO BECKOLAS'S SWORD, GREEN SILK WITH GOLD LEAVES, A FAVOUR TO CARRY. HE HAS LOST IT, AND HE IS TOO PROUD TO TELL ME. FIND IT FOR ME? AND LET HIM BE THE ONE TO GIVE IT BACK. ASK AROUND THE GLADE. ELVES GOSSIP LIKE LEAVES.
THE GREAT TREE, THE MOONWELL, AND EVERY ROOF IN THE GLADE GROWN, NOT BUILT. WALK IT AT DUSK, WHEN THE LANTERNS ARE LIT. THAT IS WHEN IT IS MOST ITSELF.

beckolas.name: Beckolas
beckolas.greet: STATE YOUR BUSINESS WITH THE QUEEN. SLOWLY. ...YOU HAVE AN HONEST FACE. FINE. I'M STILL WATCHING YOU.
beckolas.again: TRAVELLER. THE QUEEN IS WELL. I CHECKED. TWICE.

topics.a: I SWORE MY SWORD TO QUEEN ALYSSA AT THE MOONWELL, AND I MEANT EVERY WORD. WHERE SHE WALKS, I WALK. WHERE SHE SITS, I STAND. IT IS THE BEST WORK THERE IS.
SHE IS WISER THAN THE TREE AND KINDER THAN SHE LETS ANYONE SEE. AND SHE LAUGHS AT MY JOKES, WHICH, I AM TOLD, IS RARE.
...IT IS A GOOD SWORD. THERE IS NOTHING MISSING FROM IT. WHY DO YOU ASK. WHO HAVE YOU BEEN TALKING TO.

elf_bard.name: Thaelin
elf_bard.greet: A NEW FACE! SIT, SIT. I NEED SOMEONE WHO HASN'T HEARD THE SONG ABOUT THE QUEEN AND THE FIRST SWORD. EVERYONE HERE HAS HEARD IT. SEVERAL TIMES.

topics.a: I PLAY FOR THE GLADE AND THE GLADE PUTS UP WITH ME. MY HARP WAS STRUNG WITH HAIR FROM A UNICORN'S TAIL, OR A VERY PATIENT HORSE. I'VE NEVER ASKED.
I'M WRITING A NEW ONE: THE FIRST SWORD AT THE MOONWELL, A GUST OF WIND, AND A RIBBON GONE UP INTO THE WILLOW. BECKOLAS HAS ASKED ME, VERY POLITELY, WITH HIS HAND ON HIS SWORD, NOT TO SING IT.
SHE CAME TO THE THRONE YOUNG AND THE OLD ELVES DOUBTED HER. ONE WINTER LATER THEY'D HAVE FOLLOWED HER INTO THE SEA. IT'S IN THE SONG. THE LONG VERSION.

elf_herbalist.name: Mirelle
elf_herbalist.greet: MIND THE THYME, IT BRUISES. YOU'RE THE ONE FROM THE STARS? YOU LOOK TIRED. EVERYONE FROM THE STARS LOOKS TIRED.
elf_herbalist.again: STILL STANDING? GOOD. DRINK SOMETHING GREEN.

topics.a: I'VE KEPT THIS STALL FOR FOUR HUNDRED YEARS. I GREW MY HAIR WHITE ON PURPOSE. IT MAKES PEOPLE LISTEN.
AT DAWN I SAW THE FIRST SWORD BY THE MOONWELL, CLIMBING THE WILLOW IN FULL ARMOUR, VERY QUIETLY. THEN CLIMBING DOWN AGAIN WITH NOTHING, VERY QUIETLY. I DIDN'T ASK. I DID WATCH.
IT SHOWS YOU WHAT YOU'D CROSS THE SEAS FOR. MOST PEOPLE LOOK ONCE AND GO HOME A LITTLE DIFFERENT.

elf_warden.name: Aerin
elf_warden.greet: WELCOME TO SYLVARA, SKY-TRAVELLER. YOUR SHIP WILL BE SAFE ON THE RING. THE TREES WILL NOT TOUCH IT. PROBABLY.
elf_warden.again: THE RING HOLDS. YOUR SHIP IS WELL.

topics.a: I KEEP THE RING FOR THOSE WHO COME DOWN FROM THE STARS. YOU ARE THE FIRST IN A LONG WHILE WHO DIDN'T LAND ON A TREE.
UP THE PATH TO THE GREAT TREE. THE QUEEN HOLDS COURT INSIDE. KNEEL, BE HONEST, AND DON'T MAKE ANY SUDDEN MOVES NEAR BECKOLAS.

elf_lamplighter.name: Faelan
elf_lamplighter.greet: AH. SOMEONE ABROAD AT DUSK. MIND THE ROOTS - THEY SHIFT WHEN NOBODY'S LOOKING. I'M FAELAN. I LIGHT THE LANTERNS.
elf_lamplighter.again: STILL WANDERING? GOOD. THE LANTERNS ARE LIT. IN ELDERGLADE YOU CAN'T BE LOST, ONLY DELAYED.

topics.a: I HAVE LIT EVERY LANTERN IN THE GLADE AT DUSK FOR SIX HUNDRED YEARS. I COULD DO IT WITH MY EYES SHUT. I TRIED, ONCE. THE QUEEN ASKED ME, VERY KINDLY, NOT TO TRY IT AGAIN.
EACH ONE IS A LEAF FOLDED ROUND A DROP OF MOONWELL WATER. THE WATER REMEMBERS THE MOON AND GLOWS FOR IT. I ONLY WAKE THEM. AND TRIM THE WICKS. THERE ARE NO WICKS. I TRIM THEM ANYWAY.
THE WOOD IS QUIET. THE FIRST SWORD HAS BEEN UP EARLY ALL WEEK, PACING BY THE MOONWELL. HE SAYS IT'S FOR THE AIR. I HAVE NEVER SEEN ANYONE TAKE THE AIR SO SADLY.

elf_weaver.name: Sefa
elf_weaver.greet: OH! YOU'RE NOT FROM HERE. NOBODY FROM HERE STANDS THAT STILL. I'M SEFA, I WEAVE. MAY I MEASURE YOUR SHOULDERS? NO? ANOTHER TIME.
elf_weaver.again: BACK AGAIN. YOUR CUFFS ARE FRAYING. I NOTICE THESE THINGS. I CAN'T HELP IT.

topics.a: I SPIN MOONWELL THREAD AND WEAVE THE WARDENS' CLOAKS. A GOOD ELVEN CLOAK HIDES YOU IN THE WOOD AND KEEPS THE RAIN OFF. A GREAT ONE LOOKS LOVELY AS WELL. I ONLY MAKE GREAT ONES.
I WOVE IT. THE GOLD AT THE HEM IS REAL GOLD, BEATEN THINNER THAN A LEAF. SHE SAID IT WAS TOO MUCH. SHE WEARS IT EVERY DAY.
THIS SPRING THE QUEEN HAD ME WEAVE HER A RIBBON - GREEN SILK, GOLD LEAVES, MY BEST WORK. SHE WANTED IT FOR SOMEONE. SHE WOULDN'T SAY WHO. SHE DIDN'T HAVE TO.

elf_child.name: Pip
elf_child.greet: ARE YOU FROM THE STARS? DO YOU KNOW ANY STARS? WHAT ARE THEY LIKE? ARE THEY NICE?
elf_child.again: YOU CAME BACK! I KNEW YOU WOULD. I ASKED THE MOONWELL AND IT DIDN'T SAY ANYTHING, SO THAT MEANT YES.

topics.a: I'M PIP. I'M NINETY-ONE. THAT'S VERY YOUNG FOR AN ELF. WHEN I'M OLD I'M GOING TO BE A WARDEN LIKE AERIN. OR A BARD. OR A TREE.
CATCH-THE-FIREFLY. YOU HAVE TO BE QUICK AND NOT SQUASH THEM. I HAVEN'T CAUGHT ANY. I AM VERY GOOD AT NOT SQUASHING THEM.
BECKOLAS CLIMBED A TREE! IN HIS ARMOUR! HE THOUGHT NOBODY SAW. I'M NOT SAYING WHICH TREE. MIRELLE SAYS SECRETS ARE LIKE SEEDS: DIG THEM UP TO LOOK AND THEY NEVER GROW.
